question.text: How many subscribers will Russell Brand's YouTube channel show on 27 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the subscriber count displayed on Russell Brand's YouTube channel page (https://www.youtube.com/@russellbrand) as of 12:00 UTC on 27 November 2026, in YouTube's default logged-out English display. YouTube rounds subscriber counts down to three significant figures, so the figure is read at face value and moves in steps of 10,000 at this channel's size: a display of "6.59M" resolves as 6,590,000, "6.6M" as 6,600,000, and "6.61M" as 6,610,000. If no live reading is taken at that moment, the reading is taken from the Wayback Machine capture of the channel page closest to 12:00 UTC on 27 November 2026 (listed at http://web.archive.org/web/2026*/https://www.youtube.com/@russellbrand), and failing that from Social Blade's daily-metrics entry for 27 November 2026 (https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/russellbrand).
question.fine_print: The reading is the one shown in the channel's "About" panel; if the header and the About panel briefly show different rounded figures, the About panel governs. If the channel has been terminated, deleted, or has its subscriber count hidden as of 12:00 UTC on 27 November 2026, this question resolves to the last subscriber count displayed for the channel before its removal, as recorded on Social Blade (https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/russellbrand), read at face value in the same way; if no such record exists, the question is annulled.

research:
I found nothing that settles this yet. The channel still shows "6.6M" on 16 November, and the last two drops of 10,000 came about 9 days apart. One more drop by 27 November would give 6,590,000. Two correct points on the background: Brand has posted a new upload (15 November), and Wayback captures are thin.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: I fetched the live About page: "6.6M subscribers", 1,704,784,737 views, joined 1 January 2007, 6.1K videos. The header and the About panel both show 6.6M. [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@russellbrand/about)
- 2026-11-16: The Social Blade page blocked automated access (HTTP 403), so I could not read its daily table. Its latest Wayback capture is from July 2025. [Social Blade](https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/russellbrand)
- 2026-11-16: The latest Wayback capture of the channel page is 2026-11-11 13:56 UTC. In 2026 the captures are irregular: 16 so far, with gaps of up to 6 weeks before late October. That matters if the archive is the fallback source. When I tried to open old captures I got rate limited (HTTP 429), so I could not read their counts. [Wayback CDX](http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=youtube.com/@russellbrand&from=2026&filter=statuscode:200&collapse=timestamp:8&fl=timestamp)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-16: The display is 6.6M, meaning an underlying count of 6,600,000 to 6,609,999. It went to 6.6M on 11 November (vidIQ), so the count was probably near the top of that range then. Anything above 6,610,000 would display "6.61M". Nothing settles the question yet.
- Correction to the background: the channel uploaded "The Good Work Continues | SS25" about 1 day ago, around 15 November, and it had about 570K views. So "no upload since late October" is out of date. [YouTube videos tab](https://www.youtube.com/@russellbrand/videos)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: The UK government is looking into whether Brand broke prison rules. The trigger was a statement from him, read by Laura Brand on the channel, in which he says he is "not guilty". [ABC](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/russell-brand-prison-message-read-by-laura-on-sunday-service/107392812)
- 2026-11-16: Netflix released the documentary "Russell Brand: Open Secret". [Ámbito](https://www.ambito.com/espectaculos/netflix-estrena-un-documental-russell-brand-medio-del-escandalo-su-condena-prision-violacion-n6345582)
- 2026-11-15: Laura Brand presented Sunday Service alone and said it will continue in a different format. TMZ says the episode also included pre-recorded Brand content. [TMZ](https://www.tmz.com/2026/11/15/russell-brand-appears-on-his-youtube-show/), [OK!](https://okmagazine.com/p/russell-brand-wife-laura-prison-sentence-painful/)
- 2026-11-16: CORQ says Brand has more than 23 million followers across five platforms. [AOL](https://www.aol.co.uk/articles/russell-brand-huge-fortune-trial-094800000.html)
- I found no new statement from YouTube about the account's status.

## 4. Base rates and trend
vidIQ daily snapshots (rounded): [vidIQ](https://vidiq.com/youtube-stats/channel/@russellbrand/)
- 2026-10-18 to 11-01: 6.62M (at least 15 days at that level; I could not see earlier rows).
- 2026-11-02: dropped to 6.61M, held through 11-10 (9 days).
- 2026-11-11: dropped to 6.6M, unchanged through 11-16.
- vidIQ change: -10K over 7 days, -20K over 28 days, so roughly -700 to -1,100 a day, and somewhat faster recently.
- If the 9-day gap repeats, the next drop (to 6.59M) would come around 20 November, and another (to 6.58M) around 29 November, just after resolution. If the 15-day-plus pace returns, the next drop would land around 26 November or later.
- The other trackers in the background disagree (youtubers.me shows -2.6K over 7 days; HypeAuditor estimates 6,615,643). I could not check them independently.
- Earlier figures: Press Gazette listed 6.7M (undated, 2026), and the channel was about 6.6M in 2023. [Press Gazette](https://pressgazette.co.uk/social_media/biggest-news-publishers-youtube/)
- Seasonality: none expected. I could not get year-ago readings because of the Wayback rate limit.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on this channel. The Kalshi markets that were supplied (MrBeast, IShowSpeed, PBD Podcast, FTC vs YouTube, Starlink) do not match this question. The FTC one (27% for a lawsuit before January 2027) is only loosely related to YouTube account policy.

## 6. Upcoming events before 27 November
- Netflix documentary attention (released 16 November): could speed up unsubscribes, or pull in curious viewers.
- The government inquiry into the prison broadcast: could lead YouTube to act, such as terminating the channel, which would make Social Blade's last reading the result, or Laura's broadcasts from prison could stop.
- More Sunday Service episodes are likely on 22 November, since Laura says the show continues. New uploads may slow the losses.
- Spillover from Musk's support on X, more allegations reported to the Met Police, and any appeal news.

Sources: [YouTube About](https://www.youtube.com/@russellbrand/about), [YouTube videos](https://www.youtube.com/@russellbrand/videos), [vidIQ](https://vidiq.com/youtube-stats/channel/@russellbrand/), [Wayback CDX](http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=youtube.com/@russellbrand&from=2026&filter=statuscode:200&collapse=timestamp:8&fl=timestamp), [ABC](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/russell-brand-prison-message-read-by-laura-on-sunday-service/107392812), [TMZ](https://www.tmz.com/2026/11/15/russell-brand-appears-on-his-youtube-show/), [OK!](https://okmagazine.com/p/russell-brand-wife-laura-prison-sentence-painful/), [Ámbito](https://www.ambito.com/espectaculos/netflix-estrena-un-documental-russell-brand-medio-del-escandalo-su-condena-prision-violacion-n6345582), [AOL](https://www.aol.co.uk/articles/russell-brand-huge-fortune-trial-094800000.html), [Press Gazette](https://pressgazette.co.uk/social_media/biggest-news-publishers-youtube/), [Tubefilter](https://www.tubefilter.com/?p=195099)

## 4. Base rates and trend
These are Trendreport's weekly readings of the rounded display:
- 2026-08-31 to 09-14: 6.64M
- 2026-09-21: 6.63M
- 2026-10-12: 6.62M
- 2026-11-02: 6.61M
- 2026-11-16: 6.60M
- Overall that is -40K in 11 weeks. Through the trial period one notch was lost about every 3 weeks, roughly -475 a day. Trendreport puts the last 30 days at -20K. [Trendreport](https://trendreport.com/channels/stats/russellbrand/)
- ViewsBrain shows a slightly different timing:
  - Oct 22: 6,620,000
  - Oct 29: 6,620,000
  - Nov 5: 6,610,000 (-10K)
  - Nov 12: 6,600,000 (-10K)
  
  That suggests the losses sped up after the conviction, with the latest notch lost about 7 to 10 days after the previous one. [ViewsBrain](https://viewsbrain.com/channels/russellbrand)
- What this means for the 15 days from 12 to 27 November: the pre-conviction pace (about -475 a day) would give about -7K, not enough for a notch. The post-verdict pace from ViewsBrain (about -1,000 to -1,400 a day) would give about -15K to -21K, enough for one notch and possibly close to two (6.58M). The result also depends on where in the 6.600 to 6.610M band the true count sits now, which I could not observe.
- Seasonality does not really apply. YouTube subscriber counts have no strong calendar cycle; this one is driven by news.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on Brand's subscriber count. The Kalshi markets listed (MrBeast, IShowSpeed, PBD Podcast, a possible FTC lawsuit against YouTube at 27%) are not relevant.

## 6. Upcoming events before 27 November

(b) **Latest known value:** "6.6M" on 16 November 2026. This means an underlying count of 6,600,000 to 6,609,999. The display fell from 6.61M to 6.6M on 11 November, so the count was probably near 6,609,000 then. By 16 November it is likely around 6,603,000 to 6,605,000.

(c) **If nothing changed:** 6,600,000.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** at about -700 to -1,100 subscribers per day, the count by 27 November would be roughly 6,592,000 to 6,596,000. That displays "6.59M", which resolves as 6,590,000. Recent drops of 10,000 came about 9 days apart, which points to a drop around 20 November and the next one around 29 November.

(e) **Historical variation:** recent drops of 10,000 took 9 to 15 or more days. Over 11 days, the count typically moves by about one 10,000 step, or occasionally two.

(f) **Experts and markets:** there is no market on this channel. Third-party trackers mostly show slow declines of -10K to -20K per month. HypeAuditor's estimate is higher, at 6,615,643.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** the Netflix documentary and the controversy over the prison broadcast speed up unsubscribes to 2,000 or more per day, giving 6.58M or even 6.57M. If YouTube terminates the channel, the result is the last Social Blade reading, which would be similar to the live figure at the time.
- **High:** new Sunday Service uploads and spillover from Musk's support on X reverse the trend, so the display stays at 6.6M or climbs back to 6.61M.
